# Localization data schema

```
localization/
├── catalog/<lang>.json              # original wording, one file per language
└── constraints/<module>.constraints.json
                                     # reference structure (no text)
```

## `constraints/*.constraints.json`

Generated by `tools/analyze_mui.py --constraints ...` (or written manually when the structure is demonstrated by source code, as with `shell32.dll`).

```json
{
  "source": "where the structure comes from (required)",
  "source_sha256": "reference file hash, if generated by analyze_mui",
  "strings": {
    "<id>": { "len": <int>, "accel": "<letter|null>", "placeholders": ["%1!s!"] }
  },
  "contexts": {
    "<name>": { "members": ["<id>"], "coex": <bool>, "why": "note" }
  },
  "menus":   { "<id>/lang:0409": { "levels": [[{"cmd": 101, "accel": "F", ...}]] } },
  "dialogs": { "<id>/lang:0409": { "rect": [x,y,cx,cy], "controls": [...] } }
}
```

`coex: false` means the members are never visible at the same time (for example, pin/unpin); otherwise, `verify_catalog.py` requires distinct accelerators within the context.

## `catalog/<lang>.json`

The example below uses Italian text to illustrate a language-specific catalog:

```json
{
  "language": {
    "id": "it", "mui_name": "it-IT", "lcid": "0x0410",
    "name": "Italian", "needs_native_review": false
  },
  "strings": { "5381": "Aggiungi al menu &Start" },
  "maxlen_override": { "5384": 64, "dialog:6/lang:0409:title": 40 },
  "maxlen_override_comment": { "5384": "why this is needed (required)" },
  "dialogs": { "6/lang:0409": {
    "title": "Barra delle applicazioni",
    "controls": { "1105": "...", "65535#1": "..." } } },
  "menus": { "211/lang:0409": { "1/0": "..." } }
}
```

Rules (all enforced by `tools/verify_catalog.py`):

1. `en.json` must exist and be complete as a fallback for every constraints source with `"require_fallback_coverage": true`.
2. No IDs that do not exist in the constraints (an "orphan" is an error).
3. Placeholders must match in number, order, and type.
4. At most one `&` accelerator per string; accelerators must be unique within coexisting contexts.
5. Length must be ≤ max(2×reference length, reference length+8), unless a commented override is provided.
6. Wording must be ORIGINAL: do not copy or translate Microsoft text literally (rephrase its meaning in your own words).

For duplicate control IDs in a dialog, use `<id>#N` keys in template order. Menu items use `<level>/<index>` keys. See `localization/METODO_CATALOGO_EXPLORER_MUI.md` for operational details.

`tools/embed_catalog.py` generates `installer/Win7ExplorerRestorer/lang_catalog.h` and `explorerwrapper/Win7ExplorerRestorer_languages.rc` from these files and refuses to generate output if verification fails.
